name: fixture-match-report
description: Generate evidence-backed coaching reports for a selected team from completed ClubATX fixture results and match statistics.

interface.shortDescription: Turn fixture statistics into coaching insights
interface.longDescription: Analyze a selected team's completed fixture using the final result, opponent comparison, team statistics, and available player evidence. Produce a coaching-focused report covering strengths, improvements, key players, video-review priorities, and concrete next-match objectives without modifying league data.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this completed fixture for a chosen team
Turn these match statistics into a full coaching report
Identify evidence-backed standouts and video-review priorities
